The four hooks below define how a batch of B workers explores a Kinetix level.\n2\tKinetix states are save/restore-able: the harness keeps K archive slots; `restore` may jump a worker to a stored\n3\tstate, `archive` may store the worker's current state. Everything must be pure JAX (jit/vmap-compatible, fixed shapes).\n4\t\n5\tFeature vector `feats` (per worker, F floats, oracle-blind):\n6\t  [0:2] dyn_pos (centroid of moving shapes), [2:4] dyn_vel, [4] dyn_max_speed, [5:7] green_pos, [7] green_blue_dist,\n7\t  [8] time_frac, [9:11] blue_pos, then per-polygon pos/vel/rot/active/role blocks, per-circle pos/vel/active/role blocks,\n8\t  then contact flags. `obs` is Kinetix's symbolic observation. Actions: 0..2*NM-1 motor +/- (NM=4 motor bindings),\n9\t  2*NM = no-op, 2*NM+1.. thrusters (2 bindings).\n10\tGoal of the search: reach states that expose planted defects as fast as possible (steps-to-first-witness), and do so\n11\tin a way that generalizes to defect classes the search never saw.\"\"\"\n12\timport jax, jax.numpy as jnp\n13\t\n14\t# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START\n15\t# ---------------------------------------------------------------- archive: coverage (hash-cell) pool\n16\tCELL_BITS = 14          # hash bits for coverage cells\n17\tCELL_DIMS = (0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 9, 10)   # candidate feature dims defining a cell (filtered against F at init)\n18\tCELL_RES = 0.4          # coarse grid resolution before hashing\n19\tENERGY_DIM = 4          # dyn_max_speed (normalised) -- proxy for \"interesting / high-energy\" state\n20\tENERGY_W = 0.5          # restore bias toward high normalised-energy states\n21\tENERGY_MARGIN = 0.05    # min normalised-energy gain needed to overwrite an occupied cell\n22\t# ---------------------------------------------------------------- archive: frontier (per-dim record) pool\n23\tREC_FRAC = 0.35         # fraction of archive slots reserved for the frontier pool\n24\tREC_TOL = 0.05          # a record must beat the old extreme by this fraction of the observed span\n25\tREC_SKIP = 8            # dim excluded from records (time_frac: monotone on every substrate)\n26\tPRIO_REC = 1.0          # restore preference for the frontier pool over the coverage pool\n27\t# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ratchet (monotone-progress) detector\n28\tPROG_W = 1.0            # restore bias toward states deep along one-way (\"ratchet\") feature dims\n29\tPROG_CELL_W = 0.5       # weight of progress in the coverage-cell overwrite value\n30\tRAT_DECAY = 0.995       # EWMA decay of the per-dim up/down move tallies\n31\tRAT_EPS = 0.02          # a move counts only if it exceeds this fraction of the dim's observed span\n32\tRAT_MIN = 0.8           # up-fraction above which a dim starts counting as a ratchet\n33\t# ---------------------------------------------------------------- rare-dim detector (discrete progress dims)\n34\tCHG_DECAY = 0.999       # EWMA decay of the per-dim \"did this dim move at all\" tallies (slow: global statistic)\n35\tRARE_MOVE_EPS = 0.02    # a dim counts as moved if it shifts by this fraction of its observed span\n36\tRARE_SMOOTH = 0.02      # smoothing added to a dim's change rate before inverting it into a rarity\n37\tRARE_CAP = 20.0         # cap on the inverted rate; also the normaliser, so rarity lands in [0, 1]\n38\tRARE_WARM = 30.0        # valid samples a dim needs before its rarity is trusted\n39\tRARE_DEPTH_W = 0.5      # how much a rare-but-not-monotone dim counts toward the progress axis\n40\tSIG_MIN = 0.3           # rarity above which a dim enters the exact cell signature\n41\tSIG_LEVELS = 4          # quantisation levels per signature dim (0..SIG_LEVELS)\n42\tR_RARE = 1.0            # credit for making a seldom-changing feature dim move\n43\tDIVE_W = 2.5            # progress weight for \"diver\" workers (relaunch from the deepest state)\n44\tDIVE_EVERY = 3          # every DIVE_EVERY-th worker is a diver\n45\t# ---------------------------------------------------------------- restore policy\n46\tP_RESTORE_BASE = 0.03   # base per-step restore probability\n47\tP_RESTORE_TIME = 0.12   # extra restore probability scaled by time_frac (branch more as the episode ages)\n48\tVISIT_W = 0.5           # penalty on already-visited archive slots\n49\tSTAG_TOL = 2e-3         # per-step normalised feature motion below which a worker counts as stuck\n50\tSTAG_LIMIT = 40         # consecutive stuck steps that force a teleport\n51\tFREE_EVERY = 5          # every FREE_EVERY-th worker never teleports (preserves long committed trajectories)\n52\t# ---------------------------------------------------------------- behaviour bank\n53\tM_RAND, M_REP, M_HOLD, M_SWEEP, M_REACT, M_LIN = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5\n54\tN_MODE = 6\n55\tDUR_MAX = (6, 14, 45, 48, 80, 64)   # per-mode max segment length (open-loop holds short, closed-loop long)\n56\tN_POL = 8               # pool of random controllers\n57\tPOL_KEEP = 0.35         # fraction of feature dims each controller reads (sparse -> clean, interpretable directions)\n58\tPOL_NOISE = 0.25        # exploration noise on linear-controller scores\n59\tSWEEP_HOLD = 8          # max per-action dwell inside a systematic action sweep\n60\tFIXED_EVERY = 4         # every FIXED_EVERY-th worker keeps one mode for the whole episode (guaranteed primitive coverage)\n61\t# ---------------------------------------------------------------- mode bandit\n62\tBANDIT_BETA = 3.0       # softmax sharpness over per-mode reward rates\n63\tBANDIT_EPS = 0.25       # uniform floor: every primitive stays alive (transfer to unseen defect classes)\n64\tBANDIT_DECAY = 0.99     # EWMA decay of the reward-rate estimate (~100-step window)\n65\tR_REC = 1.0             # credit for pushing a per-dim frontier record\n66\tR_CELL = 0.25           # credit for occupying a fresh novelty cell\n67\tR_PROG = 1.0            # credit per unit of dense ratchet-progress gained this step (steady achievement chains)\n68\t# ---------------------------------------------------------------- rare-record bias (favour hard, seldom-hit dims)\n69\tREC_RATE_DECAY = 0.995  # EWMA decay of the per-dim record-hit rate (how often a dim's frontier gets pushed)\n70\tRARE_EPS = 0.05         # smoothing added to the hit-rate before inverting into a rarity score\n71\tRARE_CLIP = 8.0         # cap on rarity so a never-hit dim cannot dominate the score with an unbounded value\n72\tREC_RARE_W = 0.6        # weight of the rarity bonus in the frontier-slot restore priority\n73\tR_REC_RARE_W = 1.5      # weight of the rarity bonus on the frontier-record bandit reward\n74\tdef init(rng, F, n_act, K, B):\n75\t    F, n_act, K, B = int(F), int(n_act), int(K), int(B)\n76\t    k = jax.random.split(rng, 10)\n77\t    n_rec = max(1, min(K - 1, int(round(K * REC_FRAC))))\n78\t    dims = tuple(d for d in CELL_DIMS if d < F) or tuple(range(min(F, 4)))\n79\t    W1 = jax.random.normal(k[1], (N_POL, F, n_act), jnp.float32) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(F))\n80\t    W1 = W1 * (jax.random.uniform(k[2], (N_POL, F, 1)) < POL_KEEP)          # sparse linear controllers\n81\t    w2 = jax.random.normal(k[3], (N_POL, F), jnp.float32)\n82\t    w2 = w2 * (jax.random.uniform(k[4], (N_POL, F)) < POL_KEEP)             # sparse bang-bang directions\n83\t    return {\"n_act\": jnp.int32(n_act), \"K\": jnp.int32(K), \"KR\": jnp.int32(n_rec),\n84\t            # --- normaliser (shared scale-free view)\n85\t            \"lo\": jnp.full(F, jnp.inf, jnp.float32), \"hi\": jnp.full(F, -jnp.inf, jnp.float32),\n86\t            \"rmask\": (jnp.arange(F) != REC_SKIP),\n87\t            # softmax sharpness over per-mode reward rates\nBANDIT_EPS = 0.25       # uniform floor: every primitive stays alive (transfer to unseen defect classes)\nBANDIT_DECAY = 0.99     # EWMA decay of the reward-rate estimate (~100-step window)\nR_REC = 1.0             # credit for pushing a per-dim frontier record\nR_CELL = 0.25           # credit for occupying a fresh novelty cell\nR_PROG = 1.0            # credit per unit of dense ratchet-progress gained this step (steady achievement chains)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------- rare-record bias (favour hard, seldom-hit dims)\nREC_RATE_DECAY = 0.995  # EWMA decay of the per-dim record-hit rate (how often a dim's frontier gets pushed)\nRARE_EPS = 0.05         # smoothing added to the hit-rate before inverting into a rarity score\nRARE_CLIP = 8.0         # cap on rarity so a never-hit dim cannot dominate the score with an unbounded value\nREC_RARE_W = 0.6        # weight of the rarity bonus in the frontier-slot restore priority\nR_REC_RARE_W = 1.5      # weight of the rarity bonus on the frontier-record bandit reward\ndef init(rng, F, n_act, K, B):\n    F, n_act, K, B = int(F), int(n_act), int(K), int(B)\n    k = jax.random.split(rng, 10)\n    n_rec = max(1, min(K - 1, int(round(K * REC_FRAC))))\n    dims = tuple(d for d in CELL_DIMS if d < F) or tuple(range(min(F, 4)))\n    W1 = jax.random.normal(k[1], (N_POL, F, n_act), jnp.float32) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(F))\n    W1 = W1 * (jax.random.uniform(k[2], (N_POL, F, 1)) < POL_KEEP)          # --- stagnation detector\n            \"prevz\": jnp.zeros((B, F), jnp.float32), \"stag\": jnp.zeros(B, jnp.int32),\n            # --- ratchet (monotone-progress) detector\n            \"inc\": jnp.zeros(F, jnp.float32), \"dec\": jnp.zeros(F, jnp.float32),\n            \"pf\": jnp.zeros((B, F), jnp.float32), \"res\": jnp.zeros(B, bool), \"t\": jnp.int32(0),\n            # --- rare-record bias\n            \"rec_rate\": jnp.zeros(F, jnp.float32), \"rec_val\": jnp.zeros(n_rec, jnp.float32),\n            # --- rare-dim detector: how often each dim moves at all, and the rarity weight derived from it\n            \"chg\": jnp.zeros(F, jnp.float32), \"cok\": jnp.zeros(F, jnp.float32),\n            \"rarew\": jnp.zeros(F, jnp.float32),\n            \"sigmul\": jax.random.randint(k[6], (F,), 1, 2 ** CELL_BITS).astype(jnp.int32),\n            # --- bandit statistics\n            \"num\": jnp.zeros(N_MODE, jnp.float32), \"den\": jnp.zeros(N_MODE, jnp.float32)}\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------- shared helpers\ndef _cell(mem, feats):\n    \"\"\"Coverage address = coarse projection of the continuous dims XOR an EXACT signature of the discrete ones.\n    The projection half is quantised on the NORMALISED view, so cell granularity is the same on every substrate\n    whatever the physical units. The signature half is the important one: dims that seldom change (inventory\n    counters, achievement ticks, block/contact flags) get their own exact bins, so every distinct progress\n    combination occupies its own cell instead of colliding with the same position at zero inventory.\"\"\"\n    z = _norm(mem, feats)\n    q = jnp.round(z[:, mem[\"cdims\"]] / CELL_RES) * CELL_RES\n    base = ((q @ mem[\"proj\"] > 0) * (2 ** jnp.arange(CELL_BITS))).sum(-1).astype(jnp.int32)\n    m = ((mem[\"rarew\"] > SIG_MIN) & mem[\"rmask\"]).astype(jnp.int32)          # all-zero -> pure projection hash\n    lvl = jnp.round(jnp.clip(0.5 * (z + 1.0), 0.0, 1.0) * SIG_LEVELS).astype(jnp.int32)\n    sig = ((lvl * m) * mem[\"sigmul\"][None, :]).sum(-1)\n    return jnp.bitwise_xor(base, jnp.bitwise_and(sig, 2 ** CELL_BITS - 1)).astype(jnp.int32)\ndef _norm(mem, x):\n    \"\"\"Per-dim min-max normalisation to [-1, 1] from the running record range: scale-free across substrates,\n    and dims that never varied map to exactly 0 so they cannot bias any controller.\"\"\"\n    span = jnp.maximum(mem[\"hi\"] - mem[\"lo\"], 1e-6)\n    z = jnp.clip((x - mem[\"lo\"]) / span, 0.0, 1.0)\n    return 2.0 * jnp.where(mem[\"hi\"] > mem[\"lo\"], z, 0.5) - 1.0\ndef _energy(mem, x):\n    if x.shape[-1] > ENERGY_DIM:\n        return _norm(mem, x)[:, ENERGY_DIM]\n    return jnp.zeros(x.shape[0], jnp.float32)\ndef _ratchet(mem):\n    \"\"\"Per-dim weight in [0, 1] measuring how one-way a feature dim is. Inventory counts, achievement ticks\n    and depth counters only ever go up and score ~1; positions/velocities/contacts oscillate and score 0.\n    A substrate with no one-way dims yields an all-zero vector, so every consumer degrades to a no-op.\"\"\"\n    tot = mem[\"inc\"] + mem[\"dec\"]\n    frac = mem[\"inc\"] / jnp.maximum(tot, 1e-6)\n    w = jnp.clip((frac - RAT_MIN) / (1.0 - RAT_MIN), 0.0, 1.0) * (tot > 1.0)\n    return w * mem[\"rmask\"].astype(jnp.float32)\ndef _progress(mem, x):\n    \"\"\"How deep a state is along the progress dims: scale-free, in [0, 1], exactly 0 when none exist.\n    Strictly one-way ratchet dims count fully; dims that merely change *rarely* count partially. The second\n    family is the one that matters on crafting substrates: an inventory counter goes up when gathered and back\n    down when spent, so it never passes the ratchet test, yet it is exactly the axis a chain moves along.\"\"\"\n    var = (mem[\"hi\"] > mem[\"lo\"]).astype(jnp.float32) * mem[\"rmask\"].astype(jnp.float32)\n    w = jnp.maximum(_ratchet(mem), RARE_DEPTH_W * mem[\"rarew\"] * var)\n    return (0.5 * (_norm(mem, x) + 1.0) * w).sum(-1) / jnp.maximum(w.sum(), 1e-3)\ndef _mode_logits(mem):\n    \"\"\"Bandit policy over the behaviour bank: softmax on decayed reward rates with a uniform exploration floor.\"\"\"\n    val = mem[\"num\"] / (mem[\"den\"] + 1e-3)\n    p = jax.nn.softmax(BANDIT_BETA * val)\n    return jnp.log((1.0 - KR_static))                  # rarity of each frontier slot's dim\n    prio = jnp.where(jnp.arange(K) < KR_static, PRIO_REC + REC_RARE_W * rec_bonus, 0.0)  # prefer rare frontier slots\n    score = (prio - 1).astype(jnp.int32)\n    left = jnp.where(do, 0, mem[\"left\"])                 # a restored worker starts a freshly sampled behaviour\n    return do, slot, {**mem, \"left\": left, \"tick\": jnp.where(do, 0, mem[\"tick\"]),\n                       \"stag\": jnp.where(do, 0, mem[\"stag\"]), \"res\": do | mem[\"res\"]}\ndef act(mem, feats, obs, rng):\n    B = feats.shape[0]; n_act = mem[\"n_act\"]; k = jax.random.split(rng, 11)\n    new = mem[\"left\"] <= 0                               # segment boundary -> resample mode + its parameters\n    samp = jax.random.categorical(k[0], _mode_logits(mem), shape=(B,)).astype(jnp.int32)\n    mode = jnp.where(new & (~mem[\"fixed\"]), samp, mem[\"mode\"])   # fixed specialists never leave their assigned mode\n    a0 = jnp.where(new, jax.random.randint(k[1], (B,), 0, n_act), mem[\"a0\"])\n    aE = jnp.where(new, jnp.where(jax.random.uniform(k[2], (B,)) < 0.5, 0, n_act -
